record.original_question: Let X be a separable ordered Banach space such that every order-bounded increasing sequence in X has a supremum. Is that already enough to conclude that every order-bounded increasing sequence in X is norm convergent, without assuming separately that the cone X+ is normal?

evidence.quote: Theorem 3.1. Let X be an ordered Banach space with normal cone and assume that every order bounded increasing sequence in X has a supremum. If X is separable, then every order bounded increasing sequence in X is norm convergent (i.e., the equivalent assertions of Theorem 2.1 are satisfied).
Open Problem 3.2. (2) Is the assumption that X+ be normal redundant in Theorem 3.1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a real Banach space equipped with a partial order $\le$ induced by a closed convex cone $X_+ \subseteq X$ (so $x \le y$ iff $y - x \in X_+$). Such an $X$ is called an ordered Banach space. A sequence $(x_n) \subseteq X$ is increasing if $x_n \le x_{n+1}$ for all $n$, and order bounded if there exists $u \in X$ with $x_n \le u$ for all $n$. The cone $X_+$ is called normal if there is a constant $C > 0$ such that $0 \le x \le y$ implies $\|x\| \le C\|y\|$.

Suppose that:
(i) $X$ is separable;
(ii) every order bounded increasing sequence in $X$ has a supremum (least upper bound) in $X$.

Question: Does it follow that every order bounded increasing sequence in $X$ is norm convergent? Equivalently, is the additional assumption that the cone $X_+$ be normal redundant for this conclusion?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a 2024 preprint (later published in 2025) about increasing sequences in ordered Banach spaces. No subsequent work resolving the redundancy of the normal-cone assumption was found in the search results.

status_evidence.title: Increasing sequences in ordered Banach spaces -- new theorems and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 3.2: Is the assumption that X+ be normal redundant in Theorem 3.1?
status_evidence.claim: The redundancy of the normal-cone hypothesis is explicitly listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Increasing sequences in ordered Banach spaces – New theorems and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Published version (2025) retains the same open problems regarding normality of the cone.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution found in subsequent literature.
